reported_success.quote: BMI also predicted higher CRP scores in females, consistent with work showing that BMI is highly correlated with CRP across sexes, and in some cases, in females more than males

notes: Original Table 2 explicitly selects female analyses; corresponding replication is Table 1 Overall Model with SUD included, not the exploratory Table 2 model omitting SUD. Original BMI–CRP p < .01 is retained as printed. Replication Section 3.3 prints p < .001, whereas Table 1 prints <.01 for the same BMI coefficient; more precise narrative bound retained. Authors discuss the positive BMI–CRP relationship as consistent with prior work but do not explicitly give a replication-success verdict for this specific BMI target; reported_success remains null.
